## Outcome
Repair the open-goal schema migration path and project a valid portfolio DAG without losing managed goal state.

## Acceptance
- Open legacy/deferred goal records are normalized losslessly before portfolio graph evaluation.
- Invalid records receive a per-goal actionable diagnostic instead of globally crashing workflow dispatch; only the affected goal and its parent/dependency prerequisite chain are execution-blocking.
- The projected DAG preserves valid goal relationships and excludes unsupported state safely.

## Verification
Cover v1 phase-evidence normalization, malformed-record diagnostics, and portfolio projection.
